build_optimizer_bmuf: build a FairseqBMUF optimizer wrapper for incremental block distributed data parallel training
create_bmuf_config: create a FairseqBMUFConfig dataclass to configure block momentum, learning rate, and sync iterations
test_block_sync: test the FairseqBMUF _block_sync method to average gradients across all GPUs in distributed training
review_warmup_sync: review the FairseqBMUF _warmup_sync method that broadcasts local model to all GPUs during warmup
refactor_update_global_model: refactor the FairseqBMUF _update_global_model method to apply block momentum and Nesterov momentum updates
